section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses a single study that investigates the verb generation task as a measure of creative cognition, highlighting its advantages over existing measures. It demonstrates that semantic distance in cued verb generation predicted creativity factor scores, even after controlling for intelligence and openness. The study also validates the task by showing its relationship with diverse creativity measures and explores the role of both intrinsic and extrinsic factors in creative performance.
